author: Kaitlyn Cimino
title: Garmin’s latest patent targets non-invasive glucose estimation
description: A newly surfaced Garmin patent echoes the push for brands to add non-invasive glucose tracking to future smartwatches.
content:
• Garmin has filed a patent describing a method to estimate HbA1c using optical sensors built into its watches.
